text:
mira: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands 12: dropping a live thread for short Qs about hybrid travel, hub passes, and small offsites. Keep it brief and we’ll answer here.

ash: Are mandatory team offsites considered taxable benefits if we cover partner travel?

hr-help: Short: typically partner travel is taxable unless pre-cleared for business reasons. Submit details and we’ll confirm with payroll.

pete: For badge resets after long travel, any shortcut besides the hub-pass form? my badge expired mid-trip.

ops-bot: If you’re returning within 48h, DM ops with badge ID and travel proof; otherwise use the hub-pass request form.

olivia: Can managers request block hotel holds for small offsites? we have 12 people.

mira: Yes, ops can do small group holds for <=20 attendees. Use the offsite booking form and indicate dates + rooming preferences.

ash: One more: remote coworking fees while traveling for work 12 daily cap?

pete: Ops confirmed $30/day typical; exceptions for long-term dedicated space via manager approval. We'll add examples to the handbook.

mira: Thanks! We’ll post a one-pager checklist (travel approvals, per-diem, vendor contacts) by EOD Thursday. Post any quick follow-ups below. :airplane:
